newsitem.title: USA: Goodrich Petroleum find tests 687 bbl/day.
newsitem.headline: Goodrich Petroleum find tests 687 bbl/day.

text.p: Goodrich Petroleum Corp said Monday it's State Lease 3258 No. 1 discovery well tested at a rate of 5.3 million cubic feet of gas, 687 barrels of oil per day and zero barrels of water from one of six productive sands found in the South Louisana well.
First production from the well is anticipated by the fourth week of January, the company said.

Goodrich is the operator of the well and has a working interest of about 16.0 percent. The company earned its interest via a farmout from Apache Corp and Exxon Corp, which own 20 and 25 percent, respectively.

Located in the the Lake Raccourci Field in Lafourche Parish, the find has about 100 net feet of pay, Goodrich said. It was tested in the Bol 6 sand from the interval 15,509 feet to 15,520 feet on a 10/64 inch choke with a flowing tubing pressure of 9,027 pounds per square inch and a shut-in pressure of 9,567 pounds per square inch.
Goodrich said it now controls some 3,500 acres in the field.
It said two more exploratory wells are anticipated for the first half of 1997 and one development well is expected to be drilled in late 1997 in the Lake Raccourci Field.
